basic_details.job_title: VBU Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor (Computer Science & Engineering), Assistant Professor (Information Technology), Assistant Professor (Humanities) and 3 more
basic_details.short_information: Vinoba Bhave University (VBU), Hazaribag, Jharkhand, has invited applications for 10 posts in 6 roles under Advt No. VBU/UCET/R/2384/2026. The posts include Assistant Professor (Computer Science & Engineering), Assistant Professor (Information Technology), Assistant Professor (Humanities), Assistant Professor (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) and 2 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Bank draft of any national bank in favour of UCET A/C-A payable at Hazaribag.

Associate Professor and Professor: Ph.D. with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level, research publications and 8 or 10 years' experience.
